note_en: QF1 TES-IG kicked off 3 November, but gol.gg shows no score, so it stays unsettled here. Polymarket has already resolved TES's title market to No, so TES's 11.9% is likely stale. GEN lead at 44.3% ahead of LYON; T1 remain the widest gap with the market.
note_zh: 八强首战 TES 对 IG 已于 11 月 3 日开赛，但 gol.gg 尚无比分，此处暂未结算。Polymarket 已把 TES 夺冠市场结算为否，TES 的 11.9% 很可能已过时。GEN 以 44.3% 领跑，下一场对 LYON；T1 与市场分歧仍最大。

series.reason_en: Elimination Bo3 between two 0-2 sides. The model and Polymarket (72.5%) both favour AL; no roster news changes the read.
series.reason_zh: 两支 0-2 队伍的淘汰 Bo3。模型与 Polymarket（72.5%）都看好 AL，暂无影响判断的阵容消息。
factors_en: Fearless: both pools sit at depth 30; AL's Nocturne (89% presence, 78% win rate) will likely be banned or burned early.
Market prices AL at 72.5% versus the model's 67.1%, so the blend leans away from TL.
Both teams are 0-2, so the loser is out of Worlds.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：双方英雄池深度均为 30；AL 的梦魇登场率 89%、胜率 78%，大概率被早禁或早用。
市场给 AL 72.5%，高于模型 67.1%，融合后更偏离 TL。
双方均 0-2，败者直接出局。

series.reason_en: Another 0-2 elimination Bo3. TSW is favoured at 63% (market 65.5%), with a 0-2 sweep the single most likely scoreline.
series.reason_zh: 又一场 0-2 淘汰 Bo3。TSW 胜率 63%（市场 65.5%），最可能比分为 0-2。
factors_en: Fearless: TSW has shown Ezreal, Qiyana and Rumble, all top-12 meta picks, giving it more flex options in games 2-3.
LOS's played pool leans on Syndra, Nocturne and Orianna, which are heavily contested and often banned.
The market (65.5%) and the model (63%) agree within three points.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：TSW 已用过伊泽瑞尔、奇亚娜、兰博等 meta 前 12 英雄，第二、三局可选面更宽。
LOS 已用英雄集中在辛德拉、梦魇、奥莉安娜，均为高争夺、常被禁用的位置。
市场 65.5% 与模型 63% 相差不足 3 个百分点。

series.reason_en: Bo1 at 1-1. BLG is favoured at 71.7%, and the market (70.5%) almost exactly agrees.
series.reason_zh: 1-1 组的 Bo1。BLG 胜率 71.7%，市场 70.5%，几乎一致。
factors_en: Fearless: KC has the shallowest pool at the event (depth 28) and leans on Kalista/Renata and Cassiopeia.
BLG's played pool (Akali, Orianna, Lee Sin, Nautilus) overlaps with high-presence meta picks.
Model and market are within 1.2 points, so the line is stable.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：KC 英雄池深度 28，全场最浅，依赖卡莉丝塔/芮娜塔与卡西奥佩娅。
BLG 已用阿卡丽、奥莉安娜、李青、诺提勒斯，与高登场率 meta 重合。
模型与市场相差仅 1.2 个百分点，盘面稳定。

series.reason_en: Bo1 at 1-1. The model has T1 at 75.6%; the market is more confident at 88.5%. One game means high variance.
series.reason_zh: 1-1 组的 Bo1。模型给 T1 75.6%，市场更乐观（88.5%）。单局定胜负，波动大。
factors_en: Fearless: in a Bo1 nothing carries over, so T1's depth of 29 versus CFO's 30 matters little; only bans shape the draft.
Vi, which T1 has played, has 91% presence but a 25% win rate. Whether T1 picks it again is a draft tell.
Market and model differ by 13 points, the widest gap among today's open series.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：Bo1 不存在跨局消耗，T1 深度 29 与 CFO 30 差异不大，仅禁用影响选人。
T1 用过的蔚登场率 91% 但胜率仅 25%，是否再拿是征召看点。
市场与模型相差 13 个百分点，为今日未开赛场次中分歧最大。

series.reason_en: IG beat TES 3-1, per press reports, reaching their first Worlds semifinal since 2019. The pre-match pick of TES at 52.2% missed, as did the TES 3-1 score call. The series ran close to the coin flip the model expected.
series.reason_zh: 据媒体报道，IG 3-1 击败 TES，时隔七年再进世界赛四强。赛前预测 TES 52.2% 与比分 TES 3-1 均未命中。
factors_en: Fearless: both teams entered with depth 36; game-by-game drafts for this series are not logged yet.
IG led every team on GD@15 (1613) coming in; TES had the field's lowest first-blood rate, 16.7%.
Score comes from press reports because gol.gg lists no score yet; game data will follow when it updates.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：两队赛前深度都是 36，本场逐局征召数据尚未录入。
IG 赛前 GD@15 为 1613 居首；TES 一血率 16.7% 全场最低。
比分来自媒体报道，gol.gg 尚未更新，逐局数据待补。

series.reason_en: The widest quarterfinal. The model has GEN at 86.6%, below the market's 90.5%, with 3-0 the likeliest score at 38.7%. GEN went 3-0 in Swiss and LYON 3-2, though LYON took a game off GEN in their Swiss meeting.
series.reason_zh: 八强悬殊最大的一场。模型给 GEN 86.6%，低于市场 90.5%，最可能比分 3-0（38.7%）。GEN 瑞士轮 3-0，LYON 3-2，但两队瑞士轮交手时 LYON 拿下过一局。
factors_en: Fearless: LYON's depth of 39 tops GEN's 32, and the model trims GEN for it; Syndra, Alistar, Anivia, Ezreal and Rumble sit in both logged pools.
GEN's 80.0% dragon rate is the best of all teams, while LYON's -867 GD@15 sits at the 0.133 percentile.
Dot Esports reports GEN beat LYON 2-1 in Swiss, so the 13.4% upset case has some precedent.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：LYON 深度 39 高于 GEN 的 32，模型因此略降 GEN。
GEN 小龙率 80.0% 全场最高，LYON 的 GD@15 为 -867。
瑞士轮 GEN 仅 2-1 胜 LYON，13.4% 冷门并非无据。

series.reason_en: Model and market agree: BLG 59.1% against a 58.5% quote, despite DK's 3-0 Swiss record against BLG's 3-2. BLG 3-1 is the likeliest score at 22.4%. Dplus won their Esports World Cup quarterfinal 2-1, per gol.gg.
series.reason_zh: 模型与市场一致：BLG 59.1%，市场 58.5%，尽管 DK 瑞士轮 3-0 优于 BLG 的 3-2。最可能比分 BLG 3-1（22.4%）。据 gol.gg，两队电竞世界杯八强战 DK 2-1 取胜。
factors_en: Fearless: both teams show depth 35 and share Vi, Lee Sin, Nautilus, Jarvan IV and Kai'Sa, so neither gains a pool edge.
BLG's 87.5% first-blood rate is near the top; DK sit at 50.0% but take first tower 75.0% of the time.
Mid is close: ShowMaker 9.0 KDA and +389 GD@15, Knight 8.4 KDA and +412; Viper's -463 GD@15 is BLG's soft spot.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：两队深度都是 35，共有蔚、李青、皇子、卡莎等。
BLG 一血率 87.5% 名列前茅；DK 一血 50.0%、一塔 75.0%。
中路接近：ShowMaker +389，Knight +412。

series.reason_en: T1 are clear favourites at 73.0%, though the market goes further at 81.5%. T1 finished Swiss 3-1 and KC 3-2 after coming through Play-In. T1 3-1 is the likeliest score at 27.4%, and KC's deeper pool keeps the upset alive.
series.reason_zh: T1 以 73.0% 明显占优，市场更高（81.5%）。T1 瑞士轮 3-1，KC 从入围赛打到 3-2。最可能比分 T1 3-1（27.4%），KC 更深的英雄池保留了爆冷可能。
factors_en: Fearless: KC's depth of 39 beats T1's 35, and the model trims T1 for it; Lee Sin, Jhin, Alistar, Galio, Nautilus and Syndra sit in both logged pools.
T1 take first tower 80.0% of the time, near the top of the field; KC answer with 64.5% dragon control.
Lane threats: Doran 7.8 KDA and 700 DPM for T1, Caliste 763 DPM and 77.6% KP for KC, despite his -147 GD@15.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：KC 深度 39 高于 T1 的 35；李青、烬、辛德拉等共有。
T1 一塔率 80.0% 名列前茅；KC 以 64.5% 的小龙率回应。
Doran DPM 700；Caliste DPM 763。

champion.reason_en: 44.3% (implied 2.26) sits a little under the 47.1% market. GEN went 3-0 in Swiss, are 86.6% against LYON and lead every team with an 80.0% dragon rate. The assumed path then meets the TES/IG winner in the semifinal.
champion.reason_zh: 44.3%（隐含 2.26）略低于市场 47.1%。GEN 瑞士轮 3-0，对 LYON 胜率 86.6%，小龙率 80.0% 全场最高。按假定对阵，半决赛遇 TES/IG 胜者。

champion.reason_en: 19.3% (implied 5.18) sits above the 13.7% market. BLG are 59.1% over DK, and Knight plus an 87.5% first-blood rate drive the number. A 3-2 Swiss record and Viper's -463 GD@15 explain why the market is cooler.
champion.reason_zh: 19.3%（隐含 5.18）高于市场 13.7%。BLG 对 DK 胜率 59.1%，Knight 与 87.5% 一血率是支撑。瑞士轮 3-2 和 Viper 的 -463 或是市场更保守的原因。

champion.reason_en: 6.6% (implied 15.15) trails the 8.7% market. The simulation still prices IG at 47.8% in QF1, while the market appears to treat them as through because TES's title market is resolved. IG's 1613 GD@15 leads the field; a 37.5% Nashor rate is the weak spot.
champion.reason_zh: 6.6%（隐含 15.15）低于市场 8.7%。模拟仍按 IG 八强胜率 47.8% 计算，而 TES 夺冠市场已结算，市场似已视 IG 晋级。IG 的 GD@15 为 1613 居首，大龙率 37.5% 是弱点。

champion.reason_en: 8.5% (implied 11.76) matches the 8.5% market. DK went 3-0 in Swiss and ShowMaker has a 9.0 KDA, but DK are only 40.9% against BLG in the quarterfinal, which caps the title number.
champion.reason_zh: 8.5%（隐含 11.76）与市场 8.5% 一致。DK 瑞士轮 3-0，ShowMaker KDA 9.0，但八强对 BLG 仅 40.9%，压低了夺冠概率。

champion.reason_en: 8.0% (implied 12.50) is well below the 19.7% market, the largest gap among live teams. T1 are 73.0% over KC, but the model then expects a hard semifinal. The market gives T1 far more credit than their 3-1 record alone.
champion.reason_zh: 8.0%（隐含 12.50）远低于市场 19.7%，是仍在赛队伍中最大的分歧。T1 对 KC 胜率 73.0%，但模型认为半决赛艰难；市场溢价明显超出其 3-1 战绩。

champion.reason_en: 0.8% (implied 125.00) is under the 1.2% market. KC reached the bracket at 3-2 and are 27.0% against T1. A deep pool of 39 helps, but several straight upsets would be required.
champion.reason_zh: 0.8%（隐含 125.00）低于市场 1.2%。KC 以 3-2 晋级，对 T1 胜率 27.0%。深度 39 有帮助，但需要连续爆冷。

champion.reason_en: 0.6% (implied 166.67) is just under the 1.1% market. LYON are 13.4% against GEN and carry a -867 GD@15, so even a quarterfinal upset leaves a long road.
champion.reason_zh: 0.6%（隐含 166.67）略低于市场 1.1%。LYON 对 GEN 仅 13.4%，GD@15 为 -867，即使爆冷后路依然漫长。

champion.reason_en: 11.9% (implied 8.40) is likely stale. The market shows 0 because Polymarket resolved TES's title market to No after QF1, but gol.gg has no score yet, so the simulation still treats the series as open. Discount this number until the result lands.
champion.reason_zh: 11.9%（隐含 8.40）很可能已过时。市场为 0，因 Polymarket 在八强首战后已把 TES 夺冠结算为否；gol.gg 尚无比分，模拟仍视该场未结束。赛果录入前请勿采信此数字。

mvp.basis_en: 23.2% (implied 4.31) tops the list because GEN are 44.3% title favourites. The payload carries no MVP market to compare, so this is a relative weight among listed players, not a market-checked price.
mvp.basis_zh: 23.2%（隐含 4.31）居首，因 GEN 以 44.3% 领跑夺冠。payload 无 MVP 市场可对照，这是所列选手间的相对权重，并非经市场校验的价格。

mvp.basis_en: 20.6% (implied 4.85). Canyon is GEN's top-rated player by in-role score, with a 10.5 KDA, 79.9% KP and +627 GD@15. No MVP market exists in the payload to compare.
mvp.basis_zh: 20.6%（隐含 4.85）。Canyon 是 GEN 同位置评分最高的选手，KDA 10.5、参团 79.9%、GD@15 +627。payload 无 MVP 市场可对照。

mvp.basis_en: 20.2% (implied 4.95) leans on GEN's title odds rather than form: his 5.1 KDA and -350 GD@15 make him GEN's lowest in-role score. No MVP market exists in the payload to compare.
mvp.basis_zh: 20.2%（隐含 4.95）主要依赖 GEN 的夺冠概率而非状态：KDA 5.1、GD@15 -350，是 GEN 同位置评分最低。payload 无 MVP 市场可对照。

mvp.basis_zh: 14.5%（隐含 6.90）。Knight 是 BLG 同位置评分最高，KDA 8.4、参团 77.1%、GD@15 +412；BLG 夺冠概率 19.3%。payload 无 MVP 市场可对照。

mvp.basis_en: 12.9% (implied 7.75) reflects GEN's 44.3% title odds. The payload holds no statline for Kiin, since he is neither GEN's best nor worst pick, and no MVP market to compare.
mvp.basis_zh: 12.9%（隐含 7.75）反映 GEN 44.3% 的夺冠概率。Kiin 既非 GEN 最强也非最弱选手，payload 无其数据，也无 MVP 市场可对照。
